## About
Legacy A Auto of Kendall is a family owned and operated body shop. Our certified mechanics, painters and technicians take pride in every single car that comes out of our shop.
If you've been in an accident, we're here to help you step by step. We work directly with the insurance company and handle the details, including car rental and towing, so you can get back on the road and on with your life.
We work on almost all foreign and domestic cars and light trucks, and hybrids too. Thank you to our loyal repeat customers for trusting us with their vehicles. We're rated 4.3 from 30 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Accident repair at our Kendall collision repair facility.
- Paint: Paint and body work from our shop.
- Wheel Repair
- Window Tinting

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work directly with the insurance company while your car is in our body shop, and we help with car rental and towing.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: Almost all foreign and domestic cars and light trucks. We work on hybrids too.

Q: Are inspections free?
A: Yes. Our courtesy safety inspection and tire pressure checks are always free.

Q: How do I reach you?
A: Give us a call at 305-251-5401 and we'll answer any concern you have.
